place.himalaya.text: Oh... wow. Everest, right off the left wing. The whole ridge is glowing. I'm never getting used to this.
place.himalaya.speaker: pilot

start.1.text: Okay. Engines good, oxygen good. Solaris One-One, ready when you are.
start.1.speaker: pilot
start.1.heard: Okay, engine's good, oxygen good, Solaris 11, ready when you are.

start.2.text: Solaris One-One, cleared as filed. Sky's all yours today. Have a good one.
start.2.speaker: control
start.2.heard: Solaris 11 cleared as filed. Skies all yours today, have a good one.

start.3.text: Two's up and burning. Let's go see something nobody's seen before, huh?
start.3.speaker: wing
start.3.heard: Tues up and burning, let's go see something nobody's seen before, huh?

takeoff.1.text: And... rotate. Gear up. Hah, I love this part.
takeoff.1.speaker: pilot

takeoff.2.text: Solaris One-One, airborne. Climb at your discretion, contact departure. Good day.
takeoff.2.speaker: control
takeoff.2.heard: Solaris 11, airborne. Climate your discretion, contact departure. Good day.

climb.1.text: Passing ten thousand. Smooth air. Ground's starting to look like a map.
climb.1.speaker: pilot
climb.1.heard: Passing 10,000, smooth air. Ground starting to look like a map.

climb.2.text: Two's through flight level two-zero-zero. Man... it's quiet up here.
climb.2.speaker: wing
climb.2.heard: Tooster Flight Level 2-00. Man, it's quiet up here.

mach1.1.text: Needle's past one. We're supersonic. Somebody down there just heard a very loud bang. Sorry!
mach1.1.speaker: pilot

mach1.2.text: Woo! Mach one! You feel that little shudder? That's the sound barrier saying goodbye.
mach1.2.speaker: wing

mach2.1.text: Mach two... nose is getting warm. Everything's just sliding past underneath.
mach2.1.speaker: pilot
mach2.1.heard: Mott 2, nose is getting warm, everything's just sliding past underneath.

hyper.1.text: Solaris, we show you hypersonic. Skin temp is climbing. Watch your heat, keep it smooth.
hyper.1.speaker: mission
hyper.1.heard: Solaris, we show you hypersonic. Skin temp is climbing. Watch your heat. Keep it smooth.

hyper.2.text: Mach five. Whole countries going by in minutes. This is... this is insane.
hyper.2.speaker: pilot
hyper.2.heard: Mark 5, whole country is going by in minutes. This is, this is insane.

g.1.text: Hnn... okay... holding it... hold it...
g.1.speaker: pilot

g.2.text: Ugh... heavy... come on... come on...
g.2.speaker: pilot

g.3.text: Phew. Okay. That one squeezed. Vision's coming back.
g.3.speaker: pilot

g.4.text: You still with me, lead? That was a nine-G grin if I ever saw one.
g.4.speaker: wing

cloudin.1.text: In the soup. Nothing but white. On the gauges.
cloudin.1.speaker: pilot
cloudin.1.heard: in the soup, nothing but white on the gauges.

cloudout.1.text: Oh... popping out on top. Look at that. Whole ocean of cloud.
cloudout.1.speaker: pilot
cloudout.1.heard: Oh, popping out on top. Look at that whole ocean of cloud.

sunrise.1.text: Here comes the sun... whole horizon just turned gold. Wow.
sunrise.1.speaker: pilot
sunrise.1.heard: Here comes the sun, whole horizon, just turned gold. Wow!

sunrise.2.text: Lead, look east. Look east. Oh, that's beautiful.
sunrise.2.speaker: wing
sunrise.2.heard: Lead, look east, look east. Oh, that's beautiful.

sunset.1.text: Sun's going down behind us. Everything's orange and pink... wish you could see this.
sunset.1.speaker: pilot
sunset.1.heard: Sun's going down behind us. Everything's orange and pink, wish you could see this.

sunset.2.text: Solaris One-One, sunset at your altitude in about two minutes. Enjoy the show.
sunset.2.speaker: control
sunset.2.heard: Solaris 11 Sunset at your altitude in about two minutes. Enjoy the show.

night.1.text: Night side now. Cities look like spilled gold down there. And the stars... so many stars.
night.1.speaker: pilot
night.1.heard: Nightside now, cities look like spilled gold down there, and the stars, so many stars.

night.2.text: Dark out here. Just the glow off the instruments. Kinda peaceful, honestly.
night.2.speaker: wing
night.2.heard: Dark out here, just the glow off the instruments. and peaceful honestly.

storm.2.text: Solaris One-One, heavy weather on your route, recommend deviation. Stay safe up there.
storm.2.speaker: control
storm.2.heard: Solaris 11, heavy weather on your route, recommend deviation. Stay safe up there.

terrain.3.text: Lead, you okay?! I thought you were going into those rocks!
terrain.3.speaker: wing
terrain.3.heard: Lead, you okay? I thought you were going into those rocks.

low.2.text: Down in the weeds, hundred feet. Everything's a blur. Love it.
low.2.speaker: pilot
low.2.heard: down in the weeds 100 feet. Everything's a blur, love it.

land.1.text: Solaris One-One, wind calm, runway two-seven, cleared to land. Welcome back.
land.1.speaker: control
land.1.heard: Solaris 11, wind calm, runway 27, cleared to land. Welcome back.

karman.1.text: Passing a hundred kilometres... sky just went black. Black, in daytime. Holy...
karman.1.speaker: pilot
karman.1.heard: Passing 100 kilometers, Sky just went black. Black in daytime. Holy!

karman.2.text: Solaris, you've crossed the Karman line. Officially, you are in space. Congratulations.
karman.2.speaker: mission
karman.2.heard: Solaris, you've crossed the Kermond Line, officially you are in space, congratulations.

orbit.1.text: I can see the whole curve of the Earth. That thin blue line... that's all the air there is.
orbit.1.speaker: pilot
orbit.1.heard: I can see the whole curve of the earth, that thin blue line that's all the air there is.

orbit.2.text: Lead... it's so small. Everything we've ever known, right there under us.
orbit.2.speaker: wing
orbit.2.heard: led, it's so small, everything we've ever known right there under us.

reentry.1.text: Getting hot! Plasma all over the canopy. Bit of a ride here, hang on...
reentry.1.speaker: pilot
reentry.1.heard: Getting hot. Plasma all over the canopy. Bit of a ride here, hang on.

reentry.2.text: Solaris, expect loss of signal during blackout. We'll talk to you on the other side.
reentry.2.speaker: mission
reentry.2.heard: Solaris, expect loss of signal during blackout, will talk to you on the other side.

leave.1.text: Earth's getting smaller behind us. Little blue dot. Weird feeling, leaving home.
leave.1.speaker: pilot
leave.1.heard: Earth's getting smaller behind us. Little blue dot, weird feeling, leaving home.

leave.2.text: Solaris, you're on your way. From here on, every word takes a little longer to reach us.
leave.2.speaker: mission
leave.2.heard: Solaris, you're on your way. From here on, every word takes a little longer to reach us.

cruise.1.text: Long way still. Ever think about how quiet it is out here? Just us and the engines.
cruise.1.speaker: wing
cruise.1.heard: Long way still. Everything about how quiet it is out here, just us and the engines.

cruise.3.text: Solaris, all your systems look green from here. Sit back, enjoy the view.
cruise.3.speaker: mission
cruise.3.heard: Solaris, all your systems look green from here. Sit back and enjoy the view.

cruise.5.text: Uh... checking fuel... we're fine. Plenty. Just enjoying the quiet.
cruise.5.speaker: pilot
cruise.5.heard: uh, checking fuel, or fine, plenty, just enjoying the quiet.

cruise.6.text: You know... done this a hundred times. Still gives me goosebumps.
cruise.6.speaker: pilot
cruise.6.heard: You know, done this a hundred times, still gives me goosebumps.

react.awe.4.text: I... don't even have words for that.
react.awe.4.speaker: pilot
react.awe.4.heard: I don't even have words for that.

react.calm.2.text: Solaris One-One, radar contact. Nice to have you with us.
react.calm.2.speaker: control
react.calm.2.heard: Salaris11, radar contact. Nice to have you with us.
